Commissione, notizie.titolo: European Maritime Day 2027
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The call for the EMD 2027 workshops has now been launched! EMD workshops are selected through a competitive process. Check the guidelines carefully: proposals should demonstrate a clear European perspective and strive for gender and geographical balance.

Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission has released the 2026 edition of the EU Fish Market report, presenting the latest trends in the European fisheries and aquaculture market.

Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The consultation invites feedback on the Committee of European Auditing Oversight Bodies’ (CEAOB) technical advice, as well as on their proposed adjustments to the international standard.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Mark your calendars: European Sustainable Energy Week 23-25 June 2027
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: As Europe continues to strengthen its energy security, competitiveness and resilience, the European Sustainable Energy Week (EUSEW) will bring the clean energy community together to discuss key policy trends and perspectives.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU announces €30 million in additional funding to support innovative start-ups in the Western Balkans
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, at the EU–Western Balkans Investment Conference in Tirana, the European Commission announced €30 million in additional funding for innovative start-ups and SMEs in the Western Balkans.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: 2027 arrangements for the execution of transfers between the emission trading registries of the EU and Switzerland
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The 2027 arrangements for the transfers of emission allowances between the registries of the EU Emissions Trading System and the Swiss Emissions Trading System have been agreed, in application of the EU and Swiss Linking Agreement.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU launches Supply Chain Early Warning Network with Trans-Pacific bloc
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The EU and the members of the Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP) today launched the EU-CPTPP Supply Chain Early Warning Network.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission approves €10.5 million Greek State aid to fishery and aquaculture companies facing increased fuel prices
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission has approved a €10.5 million Greek State aid scheme to support shipowners in the fishery and aquaculture industries facing increased fuel prices due to the Middle East crisis.

Commissione, notizie.descrizione: On 22 October 2026, the European Commission’s Directorate-General for Defence Industry and Space (DG DEFIS) held a landmark workshop in Brussels, opening a structured dialogue between the space ecosystem and the sustainable finance community for the first time. Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Czechia officially presented its national hub for financing affordable housing (FinHub), which will be led by the State Fund for Investment Promotion (SFPI).

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission prolongs State aid framework to support sectors affected by Middle East crisis until June 2027
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission has prolonged the Middle East Crisis Temporary State aid Framework (METSAF) by six months until 30 June 2027.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Europol connects police across borders to tackle drug trafficking
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: In 2026, Europol supported several international operations to disrupt large-scale drug production and distribution, resulting in arrests and seizure of criminal assets.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Rural Development Programmes 2014–2022 delivered tangible results across rural Europe
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The 2014–2022 Rural Development Programmes played a key role in supporting farmers, foresters, rural businesses and local communities across the 27 EU Member States.

Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Businesses and authorities now have an extra eight months — until 1 September 2027 — to prepare for mandatory green-listed waste reporting.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission fines Firmenich, Givaudan and IFF €471.9 million for participating in an international fragrance cartel
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The Commission has fined Firmenich, Givaudan and International Flavors & Fragrances (IFF), the three largest worldwide fragrance producers, a total of €471.9 million for participating in an international cartel in the fragrance sector, in breach of EU competition rules.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission issues positive opinion on the compatibility of a sustainability agreement in the French wine sector with competition rules for agriculture
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The Commission issued today its second opinion regarding the compatibility of a sustainability agreement with competition rules for the agricultural sector.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Statement by President von der Leyen with President Costa following the EU-Western Balkans Summit
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: I am convinced that enlargement is a strategic imperative for Europe.

Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, President of the European Commission Ursula von der Leyen and President of the European Council António Costa will co-host the EU-Western Balkans Summit in Brussels, with the participation of the leaders from the region.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commissioner Kos in Albania for Growth Plan Leaders' Meeting and discussions with Albanian authorities
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Tomorrow and on Friday, Commissioner for Enlargement Marta Kos is in Albania to participate in the Growth Plan Leaders' Meeting and hold bilateral discussions with Albanian authorities.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Águeda brings river conservation into the classroom
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: From discovering freshwater biodiversity to learning how to protect water resources, around 500 primary school pupils are taking part in Águeda’s river education programme. Discover how the 2026 European Green Leaf winner is connecting environmental education with local conservation efforts.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: African Union and European Union publish their renewed Roadmap for research and innovation on food and nutrition security and sustainable agriculture
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: New roadmap will further strengthen the African Union and European Union R&I partnership on Food and Nutrition Security and Sustainable Agriculture.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Making energy-efficient homes affordable for vulnerable people in Lithuania

Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, at the ‘Cultural Resilience and Development in Yemen' event in Brussels, the European Union announced a €10 million programme to help communities prepare for climate risks, protect cultural heritage and create livelihood opportunities.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Representatives of European regions and local communities gather in Dublin to accelerate adaptation to climate change
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Fifth EU Mission Forum on Adaptation to Climate Change to highlight importance of proactively preparing for climate risks, protecting people, and keeping Europe’s economy productive and competitive.
